messages.subject: Calderdale House — building survey report CBV-2025-0312
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

Our pre-acquisition building survey is complete and the report (ref CBV-2025-0312) is attached to my covering note to your office. Headlines: the building is in good condition overall. The main item is the original 1998 passenger lift, which is overdue a major overhaul — budget £22,000–£26,000 within 12 months. The flat roof (single-ply, ~8 yrs) is fair with localised ponding; monitor and budget partial recovering within five years. Minor sealant and car-park items otherwise.

Happy to talk it through.

Regards,
Daniel Calderbank
Calderbank Vine — Chartered Building Surveyors
